Closing the research-only residual removes unobservable inventory rather than asserting that NZ-US has mean-reverted. Markable 10Y gaps on the frozen tape (CA-US -122bp, EA-US -172bp, JP-US -221.5bp, AU-EA +186.4bp) look policy-rate consistent, and without historical-spread, REER/PPP, or terms-of-trade anchors the seat will not open a replacement receive or pay. CA-US 2Y at -144bp is also not a cheapness signal by itself versus the -122bp 10Y cash gap.

vol-convexity.invalidation: Re-scan if a markable listed-vol surface appears, if Hormuz follow-through reprices oil-to-rates without the Mar27-cash 65bp cushion, if UST 2s/5s/30s prints allow a curve expression, or if NZ reopen posts NEW rates levels. A collapse in Mar27 toward cash that shows the hike path as the misprice would flip the rates candidate from rejected pay to a receive study, still not an options OPEN.
vol-convexity.thesis: Hormuz is overnight binary risk and VIX is already 18.44 versus 16.46, so linear equity spot is the wrong instrument: escalation gaps indexes down, de-escalation squeezes them, and neocloud credit is idiosyncratic. US 10Y at 5.15 and SOFR Mar27 at 4.52 versus 3.87 cash already embed a 65bp hike path, so paying rates overnight is a directional inflation bet, not cheap convexity. Options are unmarkable with no IV surface in the frozen packet, and missing 2s/5s/30s plus NZ-closed NEW marks block a curve or NZ rates substitute. Book stays flat rather than forcing a linear expression.
